sentences.text: Mr. D. Panda, learned counsel has entered appearance on behalf of the Petitioner by filing appearance memo.
The same be taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

3. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.19 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Addl. District Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO Act), Bargarh, arising out of Bheden P.S. Case No.122 of 2022 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/376(3)/506/115 IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Addl. District Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO Act), Bargarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Taking into account the nature of allegations, issue notice to the Opposite Party No.2 by Registered Post with A.D.
Requisites shall be filed within three working days.
5. Learned counsel for the Petitioner undertakes to serve the copy of the brief on the learned counsel for the State by the next date.

6. List this matter on 10.07.2025 reflecting the name of Mr. Panda, learned counsel for the Petitioner.
7.
As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case till the next date.
